units.source_text: 其中有三个侍女和一个女童，把冰块盛在盖子里，正在喧嚷着要把它割开来。

en.t: Among them were three serving women and one young girl, who had heaped the ice in a lid and were making a commotion as they tried to cut it apart.

units.source_text: 她们既不穿礼服，又不穿汗袗，都是放任不拘的样子。

en.t: They were wearing neither formal robes nor light underrobes, and all looked completely relaxed and unconstrained.

units.source_text: 因此薰大将想不到这是大公主的住处。

en.t: For that reason, General Kaoru never imagined that this was the elder princess's residence.

units.source_text: 忽见那边有一个穿白罗衫子的女子，正在微笑着闲看众侍女喧哗弄冰，其颜貌美不可言。

en.t: Suddenly he saw a woman over there in a white gauze robe, smiling as she idly watched the serving women fuss over the ice; her beauty was beyond words.
This was the elder princess herself.

units.source_text: 这一天暑热难堪，大概她嫌浓密的头发披在后面太热，所以略略挽向前面，其姿态美妙无比。

en.t: The heat that day was unbearable, and perhaps because she found her thick hair too hot hanging down her back, she had drawn it slightly forward, making her figure exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 薰大将想：“我见过的美人不少了，却从无一人比得上此人。”

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "I have seen many beautiful women, but not one has ever equaled her."

units.source_text: 相形之下，她身边的侍女竟像土块一般了。

en.t: By comparison, the serving women beside her seemed like mere lumps of earth.

units.source_text: 他定一定神，仔细观看，又见一个侍女，身穿黄色生绢单衫，外缀淡紫色裙子，手中拿着扇子，打扮得特别齐整。

en.t: He steadied himself and looked closely, and then saw another serving woman wearing an unlined yellow raw-silk robe with a pale purple skirt over it, holding a fan in her hand and dressed with unusual neatness.

units.source_text: 此人对弄冰的人说道：“你们这样费力，反而热了！

en.t: She said to the ones handling the ice, "Working so hard like that will only make you hotter!
You would be better off leaving it there and simply looking at it."
When she smiled, her brows and eyes were charmingly radiant and deeply moving.

units.source_text: 薰大将一听声音，就知道这是他所属意的小宰相君。

en.t: As soon as General Kaoru heard her voice, he knew this was Lady Kozaisho, the woman who had captured his interest.

units.source_text: 众侍女费了许多气力，终于把冰割碎，各人手持一块。

en.t: After expending a great deal of effort, the serving women finally broke the ice apart, and each held a piece in her hand.

units.source_text: 也有人不成体统地把冰放在头上或贴在胸前。

en.t: Some of them even behaved improperly, putting the ice on their heads or pressing it against their chests.

units.source_text: 小宰相君用纸包了一块冰，送到大公主面前。

en.t: Lady Kozaisho wrapped one piece of ice in paper and brought it before the elder princess.
